mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbox_message (recipient_id, sender_id, title, body, ref_type, ref_id) VALUES (#{recipientId}, #{senderId}, #{title}, #{body}, #{refType}, #{refId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, recipient_id AS recipientId, sender_id AS senderId, title, body, ref_type AS refType, ref_id AS refId, read_at AS readAt, created_time AS createdTime FROM inbox_message WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.sender_id AS senderId, COALESCE(su.nickname, su.username) AS senderName, su.avatar AS senderAvatar, CASE WHEN m.sender_id = #{officialUserId} THEN 'OFFICIAL' WHEN m.ref_type IS NOT NULL THEN 'FRIEND' ELSE 'PERSONAL' END AS category, m.title, m.body, m.ref_type AS refType, m.ref_id AS refId, (m.read_at IS NOT NULL) AS `read`, m.read_at AS readAt, m.created_time AS createdTime FROM inbox_message m INNER JOIN user su ON su.id = m.sender_id AND su.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM inbox_message WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE inbox_message SET read_at = NOW() WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.recipient_id AS recipientId, COALESCE(su.nickname, su.username) AS senderName, su.avatar AS senderAvatar, m.title, m.body, m.ref_type AS refType, m.ref_id AS refId, (m.sender_id = #{viewerId}) AS mine, (m.read_at IS NOT NULL) AS `read`, m.created_time AS createdTime FROM inbox_message m INNER JOIN user su ON su.id = m.sender_id AND su.deleted = 0
mapper.select: WHERE AND ((m.sender_id = #{viewerId} AND m.recipient_id = #{peerId}) OR (m.sender_id = #{peerId} AND m.recipient_id = #{viewerId})) ORDER BY m.created_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id AS peerId, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS peerName, u.avatar AS peerAvatar, (u.id = #{officialUserId}) AS official, lm.body AS lastMessageBody, lm.title AS lastMessageTitle, lm.created_time AS lastMessageTime, COALESCE(unread.cnt, 0) AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN recipient_id ELSE sender_id END AS peer_id, MAX(id) AS last_id FROM inbox_message WHERE AND (sender_id = #{userId} OR recipient_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY peer_id ) latest INNER JOIN inbox_message lm ON lm.id = latest.last_id INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = latest.peer_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sender_id AS peer_id, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM inbox_message WHERE recipient_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL AND GROUP BY sender_id ) unread ON unread.peer_id = latest.peer_id ORDER BY lm.created_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM inbox_message WHERE AND ((sender_id = #{viewerId} AND recipient_id = #{peerId}) OR (sender_id = #{peerId} AND recipient_id = #{viewerId}))
